title: 第4931章 叶炎这烂树叶子的确是从老夫手里买的第4930章 下一批再斩百帝山如此作风
content_zh:
嘭嘭嘭！
此时，一道道轰鸣声，响彻在了此地。
这些天骄，虽有大帝符文。
可，他们催动数次后，也是力竭，而后湮灭在了这劫难之中。
不过……
妖千渊牙齿紧咬，在抗衡了一次劫难后，想要再度催动大帝符文之力向着叶炎杀来。
但，还没等其出手，叶炎弹指之下，便已将其崩灭。
“不！”
在一道哀嚎与不甘之声下，妖千渊也是彻底的湮灭在了此地。
形神俱灭。
嘶！
这等一幕，也使得无数修炼者感慨万分。
谁也没想到，今日之战，竟是如此结局。
不仅云飞菲湮灭。
帝宫那些来此之人也化为了虚无。
甚至，妖千渊等人也死在了此地。
而叶炎……宛如永恒。
“劫难……”
“万劫境的劫难，若叶炎渡劫过去，那……他便是彻底的打破了桎梏，成为万古唯一一位非大帝血脉，非大帝传承人，也非大帝战将等之身而入万劫境之人，那他……”
咕咚！

一些老辈修炼者话语至此，内心震颤万分。
那叶炎，当真可称之为万古唯一。
“如此之下，他应该会安心渡劫吧？”
“他？”
轰！
不过，就在这一瞬，远处，一道轰鸣声顿时间响起。
雷声滚滚，杀意盎然。
这一道道气息之下，仿佛要将一切杀穿一般。
“这是？”
“大帝意志？”
“谁在出手？”
“这是……”
“幽族？”
“他们？”
此刻，很多人哗然，谁也没想到在这个节骨眼上，幽族的强者竟是不顾生死，催动了大帝意志，这是冲向叶炎而来？
“小子……”
“你湮灭我族希冀，让我族传承人湮灭，你……该死！”
这一道吼声，震荡世间。
此声落下，无尽的杀意顿时间释放而出，这大帝意志之威也是释放到了极致，而且，幽族的这修炼者凝神，“我等施展手段，让大帝意志锁定你真身，叶炎……你逃不掉的。”
“即便有再多化身也无用。”

嘶！
在这话语落下，无数的修炼者也是倒吸了一口凉气。
至于人族的修炼者，面色更是苍白。
content_en:
Bang bang bang!
At this time, a series of roars resounded throughout the place.
Although these geniuses have the runes of the Great Emperor.
However, after they urged it several times, they were exhausted and were annihilated in the disaster.
But...
Yao Qianyuan gritted his teeth. After resisting a disaster, he wanted to use the power of the Great Emperor Rune to kill Ye Yan again.
However, before it could take action, Ye Yan destroyed it with a snap of his fingers.
"No!"
Under the sound of wailing and unwillingness, Yao Qianyuan was completely annihilated here.
Both form and spirit are destroyed.
hiss!
This scene also made countless cultivators sigh with emotion.
No one expected that today's battle would end like this.
Not only Yun Feifei was annihilated.
Those who came here from the Imperial Palace also turned into nothingness.
Even Yao Qianyuan and others died here.
And Ye Yan... was like eternity.
"Disaster..."
"If Ye Yan overcomes the catastrophe in the Ten Thousand Tribulations Realm, then... he will have completely broken the shackles and become the only person in all ages who is not of the bloodline of the Great Emperor, is not the successor of the Great Emperor, and is not a general of the Great Emperor who enters the Realm of Ten Thousand Tribulations. Then he..."
Gudong!
Some older cultivators were trembling in their hearts when they spoke to this point.
That Ye Yan can truly be called the only one in eternity.
"Under this, he should be able to survive the disaster with peace of mind, right?"
"Him?"
Boom!
However, at this moment, a roar suddenly sounded in the distance.
Thunder is rolling and murderous intent is everywhere.
Under these breaths, it seemed as if they were going to kill everything.
"This is it?"
"The emperor's will?"
"Who's taking action?"
"This is..."
"You clan?"
"Them?"
At this moment, many people were in an uproar. No one expected that at this juncture, the powerful man from the You clan would risk his life and death and stir up the will of the emperor. Is he rushing towards Ye Yan?
"Boy..."
"You annihilated the hopes of my clan and caused the heirs of our clan to be annihilated. You... deserve to die!"
This roar shook the world.
As soon as the sound fell, the endless murderous intent was released immediately, and the power of the emperor's will was also released to the extreme. Moreover, the cultivator of the You clan concentrated, "We will use our methods to let the emperor's will lock your true body. Ye Yan... you can't escape."
"No matter how many incarnations you have, it's useless."
Hiss!
After these words fell, countless practitioners also took a breath of cold air.
As for the human cultivators, their faces were even pale.
